note: Bed Management Solutions draws on the Solutions part of the Tojo block library (Common Elements/solutions-html-generator: solutions_html.py renderers, solutions.css, the lightbulb, jigsaw, route and drafting-sheet motifs), redrawn in Bed Management's Solutions look (the fit-out, from the approved landing page) through the library's colour variables. Every drawing carries the common tool layer (Common Elements/tool-layer). Blocks marked layered are library blocks with the layer on; the rest are Bed Management drawings built from the library's motifs.

tones.rule: The background changes every four turns: turns 1–4 fit-out, 5–8 plan paper, 9–12 fit-out. Specs store no colour. A redraw keeps the theme of the turn it redraws.

variety.rule: Every turn looks different (rules/08 §2). The main block is used by one turn only in Solutions; no block but heading and effect in two turns in a row.

blocks.from: library heading
blocks.purpose: Eyebrow, title and deck, with the door plate from the Solutions landing page: which part this is and where it stands (idea, shaped, tested with you, agreed).
use_when: every turn

feedback.note: Approved with the Bed Management Solutions turns bm-so-01 to bm-so-12. On a phone every pickable item is stacked; no text leaves its box.

blocks.from: library motif: the lightbulb; the chain wrapped three and three with an elbow
blocks.purpose: The steps of one part as switches on one wire, from where the data starts to a bulb that lights only when every switch is on.
use_when: a part that is a sequence of steps, each needing the one before
showing that the outcome only arrives at the end of the chain
avoid_when: parts that do not depend on each other
blocks.interaction: Pick a switch: it is raised and its sheet opens, the current runs from the plug to it, and the bulb lights at the last switch.

feedback.note: bm-so-01: all three samples approved as templates; Sample A (circuit) preferred for the turn.

blocks.from: library motif: the jigsaw (puzzle piece geometry from solutions_html.py)
blocks.purpose: The steps of one part as jigsaw pieces locked together. Picking a piece lifts it and outlines the pieces it relies on.
use_when: showing that the steps only work together
one step makes another worth anything
avoid_when: the overview of the five parts (use the library puzzle)
blocks.interaction: Pick a piece: it lifts, the pieces it relies on are outlined, and its sheet opens. On a phone the sheet opens under the piece.

feedback.note: bm-so-01: all three samples approved as templates; Sample A (circuit) preferred for the turn.

blocks.from: library route (Solutions), layered

use_when: steps in order that end in a choice of where to go next
blocks.interaction: Pick a station to raise it and open its sheet. A door writes its line into the chat message.

feedback.note: bm-so-01: all three samples approved as templates; Sample A (circuit) preferred for the turn.
